title: Platform
text:
Platform
Discover: find every AI agent, model and dataset across SaaS and cloud.
Protect: inspect prompts and responses at runtime and block data leaks.
Govern: map agents to owners and policies.
Integrations: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Salesforce Agentforce, AWS Bedrock, ServiceNow AI Agents.
